context.p: is available for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Download it from the official website or install it using your system's package manager.

info.p: Visit and select the installer for your operating system.

step.cmd: Double-click the downloaded .exe installer and follow the setup wizard.

info.p: Accept the default installation location (C:\Program Files\Audacity) unless you have a reason to change it.

step.cmd: Open the downloaded .dmg file and drag to your Applications folder.
Install from your distribution's package manager.

info.codeblock:
# Ubuntu / Debian sudo apt install audacity
# Fedora sudo dnf install audacity
# Arch Linux sudo pacman -S audacity

note.p: On first launch, may ask to scan for audio plugins. Click OK to let it scan — this only happens once.

result.p: is now installed and ready to use.
